name: SNK retroactive referral reward accounting
summary: SNKMiner.dynamicEarned() multiplied a parent's accumulated reward-per-token delta by its children's current staked balance. A newly bound child could therefore stake after the delta accrued and retroactively increase the parent's reward; repeating that sequence produced excess SNK that the attacker sold into the SNK/USDT pool.
notes: SNKMiner was deployed with the referral contract, reward token, staking token, active reward interval, and nonzero reward rate used by the defective dynamicEarned() path. A later setPool call halved the already-active reward rate without installing, selecting, or enabling the child-balance logic, so it did not reset defect age.

The exploit receipt contains one USDT transfer involving the SNK/USDT pair: exactly 197,725.727895542134092738 USDT leaves the pair for attacker beneficiary 0x7738b2f18d994c7c8fa10e1fe456069624740f3e. The attacker financed and repaid the separate SNK leg; there is no attacker-supplied USDT pair inflow to subtract. USDT is valued at par.
